annotations.title: Name the people the book is waiting on, with an address where there is one.

description: Records who is expected to record. Somebody with an email address can be written to by send_it_out and reminded by chase_the_missing; somebody with only a name is reached in a group chat and their name is what the chase reads out. Adding a person sends nothing on its own.

people.description: The people, each as a name, or as a name and an email address. A name on its own is somebody reached in a group chat.
